metadata.notes: Conversational session skill with branch dispatch on classification. Demonstrates the A / Sequential / conversational_session pattern: state[].id for the session binding, branch composition for case dispatch, tool dependencies for web search and document generation. Source for the dispatch-on-classification + tool-using pattern.

notes: Conversational session modality: each run_pipeline call handles one user turn.
Session phase tracking delegated to host runtime via session_id (C4 delegate_to_runtime).

ENISA scoring tables (DPC_BASE_SCORES, EI_SCORE_LEVELS, CB_COMPONENT_SCORES, SEVERITY_THRESHOLDS) emitted as Python literals in pipeline.py alongside main instruct call. Not in config_emission.json (Amendment K: no dict/list in config constants).
Web research stubs (run_web_research) called after assess_turn parse when assessment_output is present and flags.is_emergency is False.
assess_encryption_status is a deterministic pure-Python function in tools.py (ENISA encryption logic tree).
Renderer: inject model_options={ModelOption.SYSTEM_PROMPT: PREFIX_TEXT} on all session.instruct() call sites per KB7.

dependencies.rationale: EDPB Guidelines 01/2021 cases 01-18 for breach scenario matching
9 audit-ready document templates for breach notification outputs
Web search for SA enforcement decisions, GDPR precedents — abstract capability requiring user implementation. See SETUP.md §8.
notes: Aggregated from 8 web_search TOOL_TEMPLATE elements: SA enforcement search, SA-specific guidance, sector precedent, EDPB updates, AI Act incidents, damages precedent, cross-border SA contact lookup, current SA notification portal.

dependencies.rationale: Document generation via docx skill — abstract capability, host docx skill required. Fallback: .md output.
ENISA encryption logic tree deterministic function — pure Python, no external deps (dep_006)

notes: Rule OUT-6: mirrored by compile pipeline; code resolves via Path(__file__).parent / 'references/<file>'

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.description: Unique session identifier for conversational state tracking across turns

inputs.name: user_message
inputs.description: User's current message in the GDPR breach response session

outputs.name: assessment_response
outputs.description: Structured assessment response for this conversational turn

reply_text.description: Natural language reply text to display to the user

session_phase.description: Current session phase: INIT, DISCLAIMER_PENDING, INTAKE_GUIDED, INTAKE_FAST, EMERGENCY, ASSESSMENT, COMPLETE

assessment_output.description: Full structured assessment — present when phase is ASSESSMENT or COMPLETE

awaiting_input.description: True if more user input is required before assessment can proceed

next_question.description: Next guided intake question when awaiting_input=True

incident_data.description: Extracted and validated incident intake data

severity_verdict.description: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or VERY HIGH per ENISA SE threshold

notification_obligation.description: Full notification obligation narrative including SA, data subjects, Art.33(5) log

t0_deadline.description: 72h deadline from T0 — ISO 8601 datetime or descriptive if T0 unknown

edpb_cases.description: Matching EDPB Guidelines 01/2021 case identifiers and similarity notes

mitigation_playbook.description: Ordered immediate and short-term mitigation steps

strategic_advisory.description: Strategic risk advisory including enforcement context, DPO recommendations, borderline warnings

flags.description: Boolean flags for emergency, cross-border, high-risk subjects, special category data, processor involvement

compliance_track.description: Compliance track status: SA notification, data subject notification, Art.33(5) log, documents generated

breach_type.description: Confidentiality / Integrity / Availability / Multiple / Under Investigation

data_categories.description: List of personal data categories involved

data_subjects_count.description: Estimated number of affected data subjects

discovery_datetime.description: T0: ISO 8601 datetime of reasonable certainty of breach

controller_role.description: Controller, Processor, or Both (Track A / B / A+B)

cross_border.description: True if data subjects span multiple EU Member States

lead_sa.description: Lead SA under one-stop-shop mechanism (main establishment jurisdiction)

prior_notified.description: True if SA has already been notified

dpc.description: Data Processing Context score (1.0–4.0 after cap/floor)

cb.description: Circumstances of the Breach score (0–2, additive)

dpc_rationale.description: Narrative justification for DPC score including base category and adjustments

ei_rationale.description: Narrative justification for EI level based on identifier types

cb_rationale.description: Narrative justification for CB components (confidentiality/integrity/availability/malicious intent)

is_emergency.description: True if <12h remain on notification clock

cross_border_trigger.description: True if multiple EU Member States affected — triggers one-stop-shop determination

high_risk_subjects.description: True if vulnerable subjects (minors, patients) — consider notification upgrade

special_category_data.description: True if Art. 9 special category data (health, biometric, genetic, racial/ethnic, etc.)

processor_involvement.description: True if organisation is acting as processor (Track B obligations)

sa_notified.description: True if SA notification has been filed

notification_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime of SA notification filing

subject_notified.description: True if data subjects have been notified per Art. 34

art33_log_entry.description: Draft Art. 33(5) internal log entry text

documents_generated.description: List of document names generated in this session

notes: Loads EDPB Guidelines 01/2021 cases 01-18 from references/edpb-cases.md via loader.py
Loads 9 audit-ready document templates from references/templates.md via loader.py

description.template: You are the GDPR Breach Response Sentinel. Process this conversational turn for session '{session_id}'. The user's message is: {user_message}. Apply all operating rules from PREFIX_TEXT including: (1) disclaimer gate on first turn, (2) emergency mode detection if <12h remain, (3) guided or fast-path intake, (4) ENISA SE = (DPC x EI) + CB calculation using the scoring tables in grounding_context, (5) EDPB case matching against edpb_cases_text, (6) cross-border one-stop-shop determination, (7) AI Act Art.62 check if AI system involved, (8) Track A (controller) vs Track B (processor) compliance routing. Return a complete AssessmentResponse reflecting the current session state.

notes: Main conversational turn processor. Renderer must inject model_options={ModelOption.SYSTEM_PROMPT: PREFIX_TEXT} per KB7.
ENISA scoring tables (DPC_BASE_SCORES, EI_SCORE_LEVELS, CB_COMPONENT_SCORES, SEVERITY_THRESHOLDS) defined as Python literals in pipeline.py and referenced in grounding_context.
SESSION_PHASES constant defined in pipeline.py: INIT / DISCLAIMER_PENDING / INTAKE_GUIDED / INTAKE_FAST / EMERGENCY / ASSESSMENT / COMPLETE.
After parsing result: if assessment_output is not None and not flags.is_emergency, call run_web_research for Regulatory Intelligence section per dynamic web research module (elem_039–elem_044).
Thunk parse: call _parse_instruct_result(assess_turn_thunk, AssessmentResponse) with _safe_parse_with_fallback fallback.
RepairTemplateStrategy(loop_budget=LOOP_BUDGET) should wrap this call when requirements include structural validation_fn checks.
